description_en: Queries the details of the QR code configuration process for a specific channel on a specified runtime, including the process status, QR code content, and the URL of the QR code configuration page
description_zh: 查询指定Runtime上某个通道的扫码配置流程详情，包括流程状态、二维码内容和扫码配置页面地址
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center get-runtime-channel-qr-code-detail --runtime-type CloudDesktop --runtime-id ecd-sdfdsx --agent-platform ENTERPRISE --agent-provider OpenClaw --code dingtalk-connector --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetRuntimeChannelQrCodeDetail

parameters.help_en: The runtime environment type of the runtime resource
parameters.name: runtime_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the runtime, such as a cloud desktop ID
parameters.name: runtime_id

parameters.help_en: The channel code. It must be the same as the channel code used when initiating the QR code configuration channel, such as dingtalk-connector (DingTalk), feishu (Lark), and wecom (WeCom)
parameters.help_zh: 通道编码，需与发起扫码配置通道时使用的通道编码一致，例如 dingtalk-connector（钉钉）、feishu（飞书）、wecom（企业微信）
parameters.name: code

schema.description_en: The response for querying the QR code configuration details of a runtime channel
schema.description_zh: 查询Runtime通道扫码配置详情的返回结果

Data.description_en: The QR code configuration details of the channel. If no QR code configuration process exists for the channel under the specified runtime, this field is empty
Data.description_zh: 通道扫码配置详情。指定Runtime下不存在该通道的扫码配置流程时，该字段为空

QrCode.description_en: The URL or content of the QR code. If the QR code is not generated or the content is empty, this field is empty
QrCode.description_zh: 二维码URL或内容。二维码尚未生成或内容为空时，该字段为空

QrCodeNotifyUrl.description_en: The access URL of the QR code configuration channel page. It is generated and sent to the user when the QR code configuration is initiated, and carries the taskId, channel code, and region parameters of the current process. If the URL is not recorded, this field is empty
QrCodeNotifyUrl.description_zh: 扫码配置通道页面的访问地址，发起扫码配置时生成并发送给用户，携带本次流程的 taskId、通道编码 code 和地域 region 参数。未记录该地址时，该字段为空

QrCodeStatus.description_en:
The QR code scan status. Valid values:
Generating: The QR code is being generated.
Generated: The QR code is generated.
GenerateFailed: The QR code generation failed.
Scanned: The QR code is scanned.
Configuring: The configuration is in progress.
Success: The configuration is successful.
Failed: The configuration failed.
Expired: The process has expired
QrCodeStatus.description_zh: 扫码状态。取值：Generating（生成中）、Generated（已生成）、GenerateFailed（生成失败）、Scanned（已扫码）、Configuring（配置中）、Success（成功）、Failed（失败）、Expired（已过期）

Status.description_en:
The status of the QR code configuration process. The value is the same as QrCodeStatus. Valid values:
Generating: The QR code is being generated.
Generated: The QR code is generated.
GenerateFailed: The QR code generation failed.
Scanned: The QR code is scanned.
Configuring: The configuration is in progress.
Success: The configuration is successful.
Failed: The configuration failed.
Expired: The process has expired
Status.description_zh: 扫码配置流程状态，当前与 QrCodeStatus 取值一致。取值：Generating（生成中）、Generated（已生成）、GenerateFailed（生成失败）、Scanned（已扫码）、Configuring（配置中）、Success（成功）、Failed（失败）、Expired（已过期）

RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于标识请求的唯一 ID
RequestId.title_en: 请求ID，用于标识请求的唯一 ID
RequestId.title_zh: 请求ID，用于标识请求的唯一 ID
